description: Mars rovers exploring terrain, taking samples and images
layout: Grid-like terrain with waypoints, rovers navigate between them
legend: Show rover states, sample locations, and communication status

critical_relations.at: rover at waypoint means rover is at that waypoint location
critical_relations.at_soil_sample: waypoint at_soil_sample means soil sample available at waypoint
critical_relations.at_rock_sample: waypoint at_rock_sample means rock sample available at waypoint
critical_relations.have_soil_analysis: rover have_soil_analysis waypoint means rover analyzed soil from waypoint
critical_relations.have_rock_analysis: rover have_rock_analysis waypoint means rover analyzed rock from waypoint
critical_relations.have_image: rover have_image objective mode means rover captured image
critical_relations.calibrated: camera calibrated objective means camera is calibrated for that objective
critical_relations.communicated_soil_data: waypoint communicated_soil_data means soil data was transmitted
critical_relations.communicated_rock_data: waypoint communicated_rock_data means rock data was transmitted
critical_relations.communicated_image_data: objective communicated_image_data means image data was transmitted
critical_relations.can_traverse: rover can_traverse wp1 wp2 means rover can move between waypoints
critical_relations.visible: objective visible waypoint means objective is visible from waypoint

positioning_rules: Waypoints should be arranged in a grid or network layout
Rovers should be drawn at their current waypoint
Show sample locations with distinct markers
Indicate communicated data with visual feedback (checkmarks, colors)

calibrate.visual: Draw crosshair marks on the camera, add 'CAL' badge in green
calibrate.code_hint: ctx.strokeStyle = '#4CAF50'; drawCrosshair(ctx, camX, camY, 8); ctx.fillText('CAL', camX+10, camY-5);

take_image.description: When rover takes an image of an objective
take_image.visual: Draw camera flash effect, add camera icon (📷) near objective, mark objective as 'captured'
take_image.code_hint: ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700'; ctx.fillText('📷', objX, objY-10); // Or draw camera icon shape

communicate_image_data.description: When image data is transmitted to lander
communicate_image_data.visual: Draw transmission waves from rover to lander, add 'TX' badge, show data link line
communicate_image_data.code_hint: drawWaves(ctx, roverX, roverY, 3); ctx.setLineDash([5,5]); ctx.moveTo(roverX, roverY); ctx.lineTo(landerX, landerY);

communicate_soil_data.description: When soil analysis data is transmitted
communicate_soil_data.visual: Draw transmission effect, mark waypoint with checkmark for 'soil sent'
communicate_soil_data.code_hint: ctx.fillStyle = '#8B4513'; ctx.fillText('✓', wpX+15, wpY); // Brown checkmark for soil

communicate_rock_data.description: When rock analysis data is transmitted
communicate_rock_data.visual: Draw transmission effect, mark waypoint with checkmark for 'rock sent'
communicate_rock_data.code_hint: ctx.fillStyle = '#696969'; ctx.fillText('✓', wpX+20, wpY); // Gray checkmark for rock

sample_soil.visual: Draw sample collection animation, add soil sample icon to rover inventory
sample_soil.code_hint: ctx.fillStyle = '#8B4513'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(roverX+20, roverY, 5, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); // Soil sample dot

sample_rock.visual: Draw sample collection animation, add rock sample icon to rover inventory
sample_rock.code_hint: ctx.fillStyle = '#696969'; ctx.fillRect(roverX+25, roverY-5, 8, 8); // Rock sample square

drop.description: When rover drops a sample at lander
drop.visual: Show sample moving from rover to lander drop zone
drop.code_hint: // Draw sample at lander position instead of rover

state_indicators.calibrated_camera: Green border or 'CAL' badge on camera
state_indicators.has_image: Camera icon or 'IMG' badge on objective
state_indicators.communicated: Checkmark (✓) on the data source, dashed line to lander
